s.note: the tiny marshmallow men who run riot in the store
s.how: Stack 2 big marshmallows on each of 12 bamboo skewers. Pipe eyes and a smile on each with 50g melted dark chocolate. Toast half of them with a blowtorch for the full effect.

s.note: the roller-skate diner where Trevor works
s.how: Cut 3 onions thick and soak in 300ml buttermilk. Whisk 150g flour with 250ml cold lager, dip and fry at 185C until puffed and golden. Mix 150g sour cream with dill and a splash of buttermilk for ranch.

m.note: the carhop diner with the skating waiters
m.how: Smash 8 thin patties from 800g chuck mince on a smoking griddle and add American cheese. Stack two per soft bun with pickles, onion and burger sauce of mayo and relish. Fry 1kg crinkle-cut potatoes twice.

w.note: a giant marshmallow man, in pie form
w.how: Press 250g crushed biscuits with 100g melted butter into a pie tin. Pour in 200g dark chocolate melted with 200ml cream and set. Whisk 3 whites with 150g sugar over hot water, beat stiff, pile tall and torch until blistered.

d.note: the drinks at the roller diner
d.how: For each shake, blend 3 scoops vanilla ice cream with 150ml cold milk and a drop of vanilla until thick. Pour into tall glasses and top with whipped cream and a cherry.
